description: This file implements the TFunctionLookup class, which manages function call representations, including mangled names, implicit conversions, and constructor identification within a shader compiler context.

classes.name: TFunctionLookup
classes.description: Represents a function call, including its name, arguments, and related metadata, with support for name mangling and implicit conversions.

methods.name: CreateConstructor
methods.description: Creates a TFunctionLookup instance representing a constructor with the given type.

methods.name: CreateFunctionCall
methods.description: Creates a TFunctionLookup instance representing a function call with the specified name and symbol.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the function.

methods.name: getMangledName
methods.description: Returns the mangled name of the function based on its name and arguments.

methods.name: getMangledNamesForImplicitConversions
methods.description: Generates all possible mangled names considering implicit conversions of arguments.

methods.name: isConstructor
methods.description: Checks if the function is a constructor.

methods.name: constructorType
methods.description: Returns the type associated with the constructor.

methods.name: setThisNode
methods.description: Sets the 'this' node for the function call.

methods.name: addArgument
methods.description: Adds an argument to the function call.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol associated with the function call.
